description: Kommunale Kläranlage is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rips-gdi.lubw.baden-wuerttemberg.de. Contains the location points of all collection wastewater treatment plants with their characteristics for urban wastewater (greater than 8 m³ wastewater/d ~ 50 p.e., subject to wastewater discharge); both the stock, as well as planned and decommissioned installations. Scale: 1:25000. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plant" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
